text: We took my mother to a hospital, but her condition didn't improve. Then I researched high blood pressure and found Dr. Supadej's clinic, so I brought my mother there for treatment. Dr. Supadej initially diagnosed that the problem wasn't with blood pressure but possibly with her brain, so he ordered her admission. It turned out his diagnosis was correct; my mother had a brain-related issue and received targeted treatment. She's much better now. Thank you so much, Dr. Supadej! 🙏
